theorems.name: Submission.section3_hasStrictFDerivAt_injective_local_antilipschitz
theorems.statement: ∀ (n p : ℕ) (Φ : Rn n → Rn p) (A : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn p) (u₀ : Rn n), HasStrictFDerivAt Φ A u₀ → Function.Injective A → ∃ s ∈ 𝓝 u₀, ∃ K : ℝ≥0, ∀ x ∈ s, ∀ y ∈ s, ‖x - y‖ ≤ K * ‖Φ x - Φ y‖
